videos.title: Murder Detective
videos.description: Sharon Birchwood was killed at her home in the sleepy village of Ashtead, Surrey; she was found by her ex-husband, strangled to death and trussed up in parcel tape.

videos.title: Murder Detective
videos.description: Jody Dobrowski was just 24 when he was brutally murdered in an attack so cruel, he could only be identified through fingerprints; his attackers were motivated by homophobic thuggery and planned an attack based solely on sexuality.

videos.title: Murder Detective
videos.description: Graham Hill examines how Irish dance champion Adrian Murphy fell victim to the fatal intentions of Diana Cristea and her boyfriend Joel Osei.

videos.title: Murder Detective
videos.description: Maheswaran Kaneshan sought asylum in the UK, but became caught up in a gang feud that turned deadly; his life was controlled by the gang that had brought him to London; gang bosses brutally beat Maheswaran, causing him to later die in hospital.

videos.title: Murder Detective
videos.description: Dean Mayley had learning difficulties and was taking steps in becoming an independent adult; on his way home he encountered a group of men who taunted him and beat him to death.

videos.title: Made for Murder
videos.description: A man bails his love interest out of debt, but pays the ultimate price with his life; his killer's lifelong narcissistic tendencies might have been a warning sign.

videos.title: Made for Murder
videos.description: When a pensioner dies following a blaze in a Cornish care home, it soon emerges that care worker Karen Pedley has a history of strange connections to arson attacks dating back years.

videos.title: Made for Murder
videos.description: Malcolm Webster murdered his first wife and attempted to do the same to his second, in a greed-fuelled frenzy; experts discuss whether he was always destined to become a callous murderer.

videos.title: Made for Murder
videos.description: As a teenager, Stephen Hough lied and manipulated his way out of facing justice for a horrific crime; it took forty years for detectives to bring him to justice, when they discovered that his evil deeds had continued long into adulthood.

videos.title: Made for Murder
videos.description: Thomas Dunkley hero-worships boxer Shaun Cummins; when an accident leaves the fighter paralyzed, he seizes the chance to become his right-hand man; however, nobody could have guessed that he would go on to become his killer.
